source: JMG CUSTOMS website revisions round 2.pdf and existing repository photography
policy: White muslin studio backgrounds for freestanding furniture; preserve actual room settings for installed work. Retain original detail photographs in galleries.

prompts.studio_covers: Replace room/workshop background with soft white muslin cloth, natural shadows, entire furniture visible. Preserve silhouette, wood grain, proportions and construction; no invented joints or parts. Professional neutral lighting.
prompts.products: Clean professional lighting, neutral white balance, authentic wood grain. Preserve product features and construction. Replace unrelated background clutter with white muslin.
prompts.boards_hero: Preserve the exact cutting board set and extend the white muslin background to a wide 21:9 banner. Keep both boards fully visible.
prompts.laundry: Balanced natural exposure, neutral whites and authentic warm wood. Preserve cabinetry, appliances, hardware and composition.
prompts.privacy: Strongly blur both children's entire faces so no facial details remain identifiable. Preserve adult, furniture and workshop. Subtle exposure correction.

limitations: AI retouching can introduce small differences. Original detail photos remain available in galleries. No Bible stand image or prices beyond Wahoo ($100) were supplied.
